subject: EMEA & APAC Q3 forecast — hygiene sweep + commit confirmations
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Amelia Rogers <amelia@fintechx.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA & APAC Q3 forecast — hygiene sweep + commit confirmations

Team,

Quick hygiene sweep for Q3 forecasting across EMEA and APAC. Finance asked for a cleaned rollup by EOD Jul 31 so we can lock the numbers for the board packet. Please do the following by Jul 30 18:00 UTC: 

- Mark any deals you expect to close in Q3 as either: Commit (legal/PO in progress), Commit - Pending PO, or Commit - At Risk.
- Update stage in HubSpot to the canonical stages (Proposal, Legal, PO, Closed). No custom stage labels for this rollup.
- For Commit deals >= $50k, confirm one of these: signed LOI/term sheet, explicit PO date, or procurement block with ETA.

I've attached a simple rollup template — paste one row per deal and include HubSpot link in the "Deal URL" column. I will compile into the regional rollup on Jul 31.

Attachment: [Attachment: 2026_Q3_forecast_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

If you have any procurement blockers in APAC that need sales ops help, loop Vivek. If you want me to confirm with the customer (FinTechX, AlturaBank), say so in your row; I'll reach out.

Thanks — short and sharp here.

Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EMEA & APAC Q3 forecast — hygiene sweep + commit confirmations

Thanks Grace — quick status from EMEA: 

- FinTechX / Amelia Rogers: $220k, Proposal -> Legal. Amelia confirmed legal has the contract and expects signatures by 8/5. I marked as "Commit - Pending PO" and added the HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789/EMEA-1423
- AlturaBank / Paul Chen: $95k, currently in Procurement. They requested pricing clarification; expecting PO week of Aug 2. I set "Commit - At Risk" until PO is in hand.
- Sveld Technologies: small $28k ARR, moving to Closed - low confidence; moved to "Best Case".

I updated the template and uploaded to the Drive folder you listed.

On Jul 28 I can ping Amelia for a hard PO ETA if you want me to.

Jonas
Account Executive — EMEA
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: EMEA & APAC Q3 forecast — hygiene sweep + commit confirmations

Appreciate the heads-up. A couple of clarifications from Finance/RevOps side to keep the rollup consistent: 

- Definition: For this rollup "Commit" = legal redline complete AND an expected PO or signed contract within the quarter. "Commit - Pending PO" is acceptable if there is an explicit PO date and procurement contact.
- Please include probability % for each deal in the template (we'll normalize later). For deals marked "At Risk" add the reason code (pricing, procurement, legal).
- We need an explicit owner and next-step (date) for each Commit deal so we can calculate expected cashflow timing.

If there are outstanding redlines for FinTechX, please attach the redline summary or point me to the shared DocuSign link. Otherwise we'll treat Amelia's timeline as vendor-provided and include it as Commit-Pending PO.

Attachment: [Attachment: forecast_rollup_template.csv (CSV)]

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the updates — nice and actionable. Quick summary and next steps: 

- Jonas: I'll let you ping Amelia on Aug 28 (sorry — typo earlier; please ping Aug 28 => actually we meant Aug 3). Correcting: please ping Amelia for a hard PO ETA on Aug 3 and update the row. If she confirms 8/05 we can keep FinTechX as Commit-Pending PO.
- Paul Chen / AlturaBank: Vivek, can you pull procurement contact and offer the pricing clarification doc? If they ask for a formal quote revision, route to Solutions Eng first.
- Laura: I'll ensure each row has owner + next-step; I'll add probability % where missing.

I'll consolidate everything on Jul 31 by 17:00 UTC and share the regional rollup to Finance and leadership. If anyone expects trouble meeting the Jul 30 18:00 UTC internal deadline, flag now.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
